summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing that CFO Robert Powers departed upon mutual agreement with the Board after serving since December 13, 2021. Powers signed a severance and general release providing six months of base salary, the balance of his agreed fiscal 2026 bonus, and continued health benefits through October 31, 2026; he remains employed through October 14, 2026 to assist transition. Victoria Hay of Flexible Consulting LLC became interim CFO under an engagement agreement while the Board searches for a permanent CFO. No deal terms apply; watch for the permanent CFO appointment and any accounting-control disclosures.
